Order 
Dated this the 3rd day of December, 2025 The petitioner is the accused in Crime No.50/2014 of Hosdurg police station, which is now pending as L.P.C.No.32/2021 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Hosdurg.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Hosdurg
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged against him are under Sections 366, 376 and 370(2) of Indian Penal Code.

2. The prosecution case is that the accused after promising to marry the defacto complainant, on 04.12.2013 at about 08.45 p.m., took her from Kanhangad to Ernakulam in a train and thereafter took her to Munnar, committed rape upon her on 08.12.2013 and 09.12.2013 and thereafter on 10.12.2013 and 11.12.2013 in another hotel and thereafter he refused to marry her and thereby he is alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, now the entire dispute has been settled with the defacto complainant and therefore he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.

4. The learned counsel for the defacto complainant/ 2nd respondent also submitted that the entire dispute has been settled with the petitioner and therefore she also prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
2025:KER:93711 CRL.M.C.NO.2722 OF 2023 5.
The petition was strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
6. On a perusal of the FI Statement, it can be seen that the petitioner and the defacto complainant were classmates in plus two course.
Thereafter, they renewed their friendship and at the instance of the petitioner, the defacto complainant accompanied him in a train from Kanhagad to Ernakulam.
On 08.12.2013, she accompanied the petitioner to Munnar and stayed in a hotel at Munnar on 08.12.2013 and on 09.12.2013 and on those days he allegedly committed rape upon her.
Thereafter they went to Ernakulam and resided in a hotel room and on 10.12.2013 and 11.12.2013 also the petitioner alleged to have committed rape upon her.
In the FI Statement, it is alleged that she had not complained to the police in time as the petitioner promised to marry her.
Prima facie the relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant was a consensual one.

sentences.text: The defacto complainant also filed an affidavit stating that now the matter has been settled with the petitioner and that she does not want to proceed with the complaint.
In the above circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner and as such this Crl.M.C. is liable to be allowed.
In the result, this petition is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in L.P.C.No.32/2021 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Hosdurg, arising out of Crime No.50/2014 of Hosdurg police station, stands quashed.
